title: DetectPage — key conditioning, hum, threshold, sustain controls
description:
Implement the Detect editor page for key conditioning, hum, threshold, transient, and sustain controls (spec §21.4 Detect, §5, §6, §8–9).

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §5 key-path pre-conditioning (HPF/LPF/emphasis/Powerline Shield)
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §6 detector engine ballistics
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §8 Pick Attack Guard controls, §9 Sustain Intelligence controls
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §26–27 Parameter Ranges and Stable Parameter IDs
- Source/ParameterIDs.h
- Source/GUI/ChugLookAndFeel.h from i.1
- Source/GUI/PerformPage.h style from i.3 if present for layout consistency

Implement DetectPage.h/.cpp:
- juce::Component constructed with APVTS reference.
- Sections/controls: key HPF, key LPF, detector emphasis (freq/gain/Q), hum mode + harmonics, open/close threshold or threshold+hysteresis, detector attack/hold/release ballistics as exposed by ParameterIDs, Attack Guard enable/amount/frequency, Sustain enable/amount/release extension/weights, feedback-related sustain toggles if IDs exist.
- Optional Key Listen mode toggle if parameter exists.
- Clear labeled groups; keyboard focusable controls; layout usable at min width.
- No DSP, no CMake, no editor shell.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: DetectPage is a juce::Component constructed with an AudioProcessorValueTreeState reference
DetectPage binds key conditioning controls (HPF, LPF, emphasis, hum) to ParameterIDs via APVTS attachments
DetectPage binds threshold/hysteresis (or open/close), Attack Guard, and Sustain Intelligence controls present in ParameterIDs.h
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: implement other GUI pages or analysis components

allowed: sectioned layout with labeled groups for Key, Hum, Threshold, Transient, Sustain
APVTS attachments only for existing ParameterIDs
forbidden: invent new parameter IDs in ParameterIDs.h
draw PerformanceTimeline or NoiseFingerprint inside DetectPage
